subtitle: Your downloads are moving smoothly.
desktopHttpReady: HTTP and HTTPS downloads are ready
resumeHint: Interrupted downloads are saved as .part files and resume when the server supports byte ranges.
dashboardSubtitle: Monitor active transfers and recent activity.
downloadsSubtitle: Manage every file in one focused workspace.
engineReadyDetail: Reliable background transfers with safe pause and resume.
emptySubtitle: Add a direct HTTP or HTTPS link to get started.
settingsSubtitle: Personalize PIDM and choose where files are saved.
appearanceHelper: Choose a palette that is comfortable for your workspace.
downloadLocationHelper: New files are saved here unless you choose another folder.
addDownloadHelper: Paste a file, media-page, magnet, or torrent link and PIDM will choose the best engine.
queuesSubtitle: Group downloads and control how many run at once.
schedulerSubtitle: Start and stop queues automatically on selected days.
daysHint: Leave empty for every day, use Mon,Tue,..., or one date such as 2026-12-31.
startImmediatelyHelper: Turn off to wait for the queue or schedule.
shutdownWarning: Shutdown is requested with a 60-second operating-system delay.
downloadBehaviorHelper: Tune connection count, bandwidth, and automatic recovery. New settings apply when a transfer starts.
siteOverridesHelper: Use fewer connections for sensitive hosts or more for fast mirrors.
perDownloadOptionsHelper: Overrides apply only to this file and are saved with its history.
pauseToEdit: Pause this download to edit options
optionChangesHint: Folder changes move existing completed or partial data safely.
desktopIntegrationHelper: Choose how PIDM works with your operating system.
clipboardMonitoringHelper: Offer HTTP links copied to the clipboard
completionNotificationsHelper: Show native notifications when transfers finish
eventSoundsHelper: Play a sound when a transfer completes or needs attention.
completionSoundHelper: Play after a transfer finishes successfully
browserExtensionBatch: Links received from the browser extension
batchReviewHelper: Verify each captured link before adding it. Remove unwanted entries or clear their selection, then choose a destination and queue.
batchStartImmediatelyHelper: Off adds the selected downloads as waiting queue items.
batchNoAutomaticStart: Direct links only. Media pages use the separate quality picker.
updateAvailable: A new PIDM version is available
updateAvailableHelper: Review the release notes and download the signed build for your operating system from GitHub.
requestAndProtocolsHelper: Configure global network identity and inspect optional protocol backends.
sensitiveHeadersWarning: Authorization and Cookie headers are stored locally with this download. They are never included in exported lists.
mediaCookiesHelper: Optional: use a signed-in browser session when YouTube requires authentication. Close the browser first if its cookie database is locked.
mediaQualityHelper: All direct formats reported by yt-dlp are listed. Video-only formats do not contain audio; combined video and audio options are shown first.
torrentFilesHelper: Select the files PIDM should download. Your selection is saved for pause and resume.
quitConfirmBody: PIDM will stop running in the background.
quitConfirmActive: Active downloads will be paused and can be resumed the next time PIDM starts.
speedUnitHelper: Choose how transfer speeds are displayed throughout PIDM.
openAtStartupHelper: Start PIDM when you sign in to this computer
multiInterfaceHelper: Select Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or USB network addresses. Ranged HTTP segments rotate across them.
multiInterfaceLimit: Works with direct HTTP/HTTPS downloads that support byte ranges. Proxies, torrents, HTTP/3, and single-stream servers use normal OS routing.
multipleLinksHelper: Paste several HTTP, HTTPS, or magnet links and review them before adding.
multipleLinksInvalid: Enter at least one valid HTTP, HTTPS, or magnet link.
clipboardNoLinks: The clipboard does not contain a valid download link.
networkRoutingDetail: Built in for HTTP and HTTPS transfers
http3Detail: Automatic when an HTTPS origin advertises h3
refreshLinkWaiting: Waiting for the next browser download. Start the download in your browser to capture its new link.
refreshLinkUpdated: The download link was refreshed. You can resume the download now.
